newsitem.title: USA: Continental orders aircraft, sees Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Continental orders aircraft, sees Q3 charge.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said Thursday it will take a one-time pre-tax charge of $128 million during the third quarter to retire old aircraft and return leased aircraft.

The company said the aircraft would be replaced with a firm order for 60 737-500 and -600 aircraft between July 1997 and December 1999. The new aircraft would put Continental in compliance with federal noise regulations, the company said.
The company said it would relase third quarter results October 16.
